result:
Regression fixed. In `anthrouter/http_util.py`, `_RATELIMIT_HEADERS` read `anthropic-ratelimit-request-remaining` (singular). The real header is `anthropic-ratelimit-requests-remaining`, so the requests-remaining value was never recorded.

I re-ran only the three rate-limit tests (`-k "rate_limit or admin_requests_reflects"`), which now pass. I did not re-run the full suite.

The full run had six failures. The other three, which I left alone, are:
- `test_config.py::test_editable_fields_live_editable_fields`
- `test_handlers.py::test_cached_tier_is_not_replayed_into_a_different_requested_tier`
- `test_handlers.py::test_locked_baseline_scopes_the_tier_slot_by_the_lock`

I haven't checked whether they predate the regression.
